objective: Isolate whether packed per-layer serving remains stable with piecewise-only CUDA graphs.
hypothesis: PIECEWISE passes because the prior failure is caused by full CUDA graph interaction rather than Triton JIT alone.
success_criteria: 1800 successful requests and zero failed requests
server process remains alive after the benchmark
/health returns a successful response after the benchmark
all runner artifacts and sidecar hashes are present
claim_boundary: Diagnostic evidence only; do not include in serving efficacy denominators or paper quantitative claims.
